d.ko: Dolls Nest is a 3D action game where you can customize mecha girls and explore a ruined world. As a Frame Unit, your adventure will pit you against the gigantic autonomous factory world of Hod. Overcome obstacles using the parts at your disposal and uncover the mysteries that lie at its center.

d.zh:
《Dolls Nest》是一款可以由玩家自定义机甲少女，探索废墟世界的自定义3D动作类游戏。
玩家将成为少女型机械“铠壳兵”，向超巨大人造建筑“霍德”发起挑战。
灵活运用各种部件克服前进路上的困难，解开世界的谜团吧。
